title: Drought’s bitter harvest of debt
description: As El Niño conditions deepen Telangana’s agricultural distress, failed kharif crops have left farmers saddled with mounting debts, wiped-out investments and little means of recovery. With loan repayments looming and rural livelihoods under threat, Abhinay Deshpande reports on the human toll of the crisis, the growing desperation among farming families and the gaps in support, as experts warn that worsening water scarcity could prolong the distress well beyond this season
